02 / HOW THEY TALK TO EACH OTHER

The architectures you'll build in real jobs.

FLOW 01

The production web request

DNS → EDGE → COMPUTE → DATA
Route 53DNS
CloudFrontedge cache
ALBTLS ends here
Auto Scaling2–40 EC2
RDS Multi-AZprivate subnet
Why this order: DNS resolves first, the edge caches static assets, the ALB terminates TLS and forwards only dynamic calls.
Security layering: EC2 & RDS live in private subnets — nothing on the internet reaches them directly.
Failure story: health checks mark nodes unhealthy, ASG replaces them, Multi-AZ fails the DB over.
FLOW 02

VPC-to-VPC & hybrid connectivity

ON-PREM ⇄ CLOUD · VPC ⇄ VPC
On-prem DCyour racks
Direct Connectprivate fiber
Transit Gatewayhub & spoke
VPC-A / VPC-Bper team
2 VPCs: Peering (cheap, non-transitive). 5+ VPCs: Transit Gateway — one hub, every spoke.
Private SaaS access: PrivateLink drops another account's API into your VPC without the internet.
Hybrid: Direct Connect gives the dedicated line; TGW makes every attached VPC reachable from on-prem via BGP.
FLOW 03

The GenAI / AgentOps request path (RAG)

GROUND → FILTER → REASON → OBSERVE
API Gatewaychat request
Bedrock Agentplans + acts
Guardrailsin/out filter
Knowledge BaseRAG retrieval
OpenSearchvector index
Grounded answers: the agent retrieves from the KB (S3 docs chunked + embedded) so answers cite your data.
Guardrails both ways: input filters block jailbreaks/PII; output filters block harmful content.
AgentOps loop: aliases (DRAFT→PROD) enable rollback; every trace & tool call lands in CloudWatch for evals.

07 / TERRAFORM & YAML LAB

Why infrastructure-as-code — and how modules work.

① RepeatabilityThe same template builds dev, staging and prod identically.
② Review & auditChanges are pull requests. Git history is the audit trail.
③ Blast-radius controlterraform plan / cdk diff show changes before prod.
④ Disaster recoveryRegion gone? Re-run the module — one apply away.

Anatomy of a Terraform module

HCL → CloudFormation YAML converter

Every Terraform resource compiles to an equivalent CloudFormation YAML resource (CDK outputs exactly this).

Tip: cdk synth generates the YAML side automatically.
